doc_summary: `native_input_key(event, modifiers)` runs after a real window keyboard event finishes handling, including shortcuts, screen consumption and repeats. event is the original winit::event::KeyEvent with physical/logical key, location, text, state and repeat; modifiers use the screen hooks' GLFW bits, captured before handling. Not cancellable. Foreign-window and OS synthetic focus events skip it. Window callback only: pad/focus/control-socket input retains its existing native_key route. The legacy native_key hook is unchanged. Bundles need "hooks": @API:input_key@.
